summary: Date field: a native date input plus a button that opens a calendar popup. Use for one calendar date; the value is an ISO date string.

usage.text: value is an ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD, or empty, and the form receives it under name. min and max use the same format; a date outside them fails validation, and its message shows while invalid is set.
input and change carry detail.value. Picking a day fires both, closes the calendar and returns focus to the input.
Open the calendar with show(), toggleOpen() or the open attribute; close it with hide(). open-change fires with detail.open on each change, and not when the element connects.
locale (a BCP 47 tag; default the page lang) sets the calendar's month and weekday names only. The native input shows the date in the browser's own format.

a11y.text: Alt+ArrowDown in the input opens the calendar and focuses a day. Escape closes it and returns focus without closing an enclosing dialog. An outside click also closes it.
The calendar button is named "Choose date", or "Change date" once a value is set, and exposes aria-expanded. The popup panel has role="dialog" and an accessible name.

roles.name: from the displayed month and year
